reason: I already pay about 20 a month for ChatGPT and it covers most of my marketing and email drafting. On 35k a year I can't justify another 59 to 99 euros a month without proof it actually does the work instead of handing me more drafts to fix.
objection: Will these 'AI co-workers' really run things on their own, or is it just ChatGPT with a nicer dashboard and a credit limit? And I have no idea how far 100 credits actually goes.
would_change_my_mind: If the free plan showed me one co-worker actually handling my customer emails or follow-ups end to end for a couple of weeks, saving me real hours, I'd consider paying.
